name: ConsentRecord
description: Records patient consent for data usage, privacy policies, and exercise of data rights.

attributes.name: idOfUser
attributes.description: Owning user (patient) — set automatically on create from the authenticated user; only the owning patient or an admin may read or update their consent records.

attributes.name: patientId
attributes.description: Foreign key to the Patient entity whose consent is recorded.

attributes.name: consentType
attributes.description: The type of consent being recorded (e.g., data usage, privacy policy).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: The version of the policy or terms to which consent was given.

attributes.name: grantedAt
attributes.description: The timestamp when the consent was granted or updated.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current status of the consent (granted, revoked, or pending).

attributes.name: details
attributes.description: Detailed information about the consent, including specific terms or conditions.
